technical_result: 492 intended-by-first-interpretation edges were weighted; base, Bevel-only, and SubD stages remained all-quad and manifold.
visual_failure: The four selected rails were cardinal midlines, creating an unwanted hard horizontal seam across the camera side and corresponding top/bottom midline creases.
correction: Move the rail chains to the four diagonal rounded-rectangle corner sectors (base indices 2, 6, 10, and 14).
lesson: A clean semantic count is insufficient when the semantic location is wrong; fixed-view Solid/MatCap review must validate edge-weight placement.
